stock.description: LFG Investment Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates as a financial services provider primarily in Hong Kong. The company offers corporate finance advisory services, including IPO sponsorship, financial and independent financial advisory, and compliance advisory services; securities and financing services, comprising placing and underwriting, securities dealing and brokerage, and security financing services; and margin financing services. It also provides asset management services; and involved in the mutual fund business. LFG Investment Holdings Limited was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong. LFG Investment Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Lego Financial Group Limited.
